第29章 入土为安-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

上一章

存书签

下一章

许默屏住呼吸，强忍着胃部的一阵痉挛，半蹲在令人作呕的污秽之中。

他从黏稠物中挑出了两样东西。

一个边缘沾染着斑驳血斑的陶制花盆。

以及，一块透着森森寒意的惨白骨牌。

指尖触碰骨牌的刹那，眼中出现一串文字。

【文明馈赠】

【注：唯有绑定者彻底死亡后，方可被其他求生者查看并吞噬】

吞噬。

方芸的瞳孔骤然收缩，指尖抠紧了掌心。

这是系统在赤裸裸地鼓励同类相食，将同胞死后留下的全部痕迹，当做养料被他人连皮带骨地咽下去。

许默深吸了一口气，强行悸动，将视线转向那个陶制花盆。

【遗物·荆棘花盆】

【品质：蓝色】

【等阶：一阶】

【耐久：10/20】

【土壤等阶：一阶】

【肥力：50/100】

【特性·荆棘：种入其中的植物，其部分组织将异化转化为防御性荆棘】

两人视线交汇，真相瞬间在脑海中拼凑完整。

这具尸体生前，根本不是误入蛛巢。

他带着具有极高防御特性的蓝色品质花盆，目标极其明确，就是为了林地深处那株紫阶的曼德拉草。

只是他低估了毒蛛的恐怖，最终沦为了这群怪物的盘中餐。

许默没有任何犹豫，反手抽出石斧，走到几步外一棵数人合抱的参天巨树下。

泥土翻飞。

一个简易的浅坑很快成型。

他用树枝将那具面目全非的遗骸连同破败的衣物一并拨入坑中，随后一铲铲将冰冷的腐殖土与石块重重压在上面。

入土为安，已经是同类之间能给予的最高规格的怜悯。

埋葬完，许默转身跨入蛛巢深处的石穴。

潮湿阴暗的石壁上，两枚散发着微弱光芒的一阶石芯静静躺在石缝中，被他一把攥入掌心，丢进储物空间。

也就是在这一瞬间。

一阵天旋地转的眩晕感毫无征兆地袭击了大脑。

许默身形猛地摇晃了一下，急忙伸手扶住粗糙的树干。

耳边开始出现若有若无的尖锐耳鸣，眼前的景象犹如接触不良的电视屏幕，边缘开始泛起诡异的重影。

【理智值：98】

他猛地转头。

方芸的情况更糟。她脸色惨白如纸，身体软绵绵地顺着树干滑落，眼神已经出现了明显的涣散。

【理智值：97】

Xu Mo held his breath, resisting the spasm in his stomach, and half-crouched in the disgusting filth.

He picked out two things from the goo.

A pottery pot with blood-stained edges.

And, a pale domino with a deep chill.

The moment his fingertips touched the domino, a string of words appeared in his eyes.

【Civilization Gift】

[Note: Only after the bound person is completely dead can he be viewed and devoured by other survivors]

Devour.

Fang Yun's pupils suddenly shrank, and her fingertips dug into her palms.

This is a system that blatantly encourages cannibalism, using all the traces left behind after the death of fellow humans as nourishment to be swallowed bone and bone by others.

Xu Mo took a deep breath, forced it to throb, and turned his gaze to the ceramic flowerpot.

[Relic·Thorn Flower Pot]

[Quality: blue]

[Level: First Level]

[Durability: 10/20]

[Soil grade: first grade]

【Fertility: 50/100】

[Characteristics·Brambles: Part of the tissues of plants planted inside will be transformed into defensive thorns]

The two people's eyes met, and the truth was instantly pieced together in their minds.

This corpse did not accidentally enter the spider's nest before it was alive.

He brought a blue-quality flower pot with extremely high defensive properties, and his goal was very clear, which was to get the purple-level mandrake deep in the forest.

It's just that he underestimated the terror of poisonous spiders, and eventually became the meal of these monsters.

Without any hesitation, Xu Mo took out the stone ax with his backhand and walked to a towering tree a few steps away where several people were hugging each other.

Dirt flew.

A simple shallow pit was quickly formed.

He used branches to push the unrecognizable remains and the tattered clothes into the pit, and then shoveled the cold humus soil and stones on top.

To be buried in peace is the highest level of mercy that can be given to people of the same kind.

After the burial, Xu Mo turned around and stepped into the stone cave deep in the spider nest.

On the damp and dark stone wall, two first-order stone cores emitting faint light lay quietly in the cracks of the stone. He grabbed them into his palms and threw them into the storage space.

That is at this moment.

A dizzy feeling hit the brain without warning.

Xu Mo swayed suddenly and hurriedly reached out to hold on to the rough tree trunk.

A sharp tinnitus began to appear in my ears, and the scene in front of me was like a TV screen with poor contact, and strange ghosting began to appear at the edges.

[Sanity value: 98]

He turned his head sharply.

Fang Yun's situation is even worse.Her face was as pale as paper, her body slid softly along the tree trunk, and her eyes were obviously distracted.

[Sanity value: 97]
